song.title: Pick or drop a song
body: Drop a track here, or press Use the bundled demo to stay on examples/demo.wav.
The desk reads the song on this machine, and this step does not start a render.

beats.title: Analysis and beats
body: Analysis draws the beat grid and the section map before any picture.
Lyric align stays off unless you turn it on, and it uses a local transcript.

live.title: Live preview and Record
body: Live plays the picture in this window, on the song, with no model.
Press Play to preview, or Record to write an mp4 you can use later as a motion guide.

brief.title: Write a brief
body: Write one line with a hero, a prop, and a place.
The planner builds the shots from that line, still with no GPU.

chips.title: Idea chips
body: Each prompt has a row of ideas. Click one to add it, or hold Shift to replace what is already there.
Shuffle moves to the next set. The dice writes one idea at random.

continuity.title: Story and continuity
body: The story step lists each shot and how it follows the last.
The card locks one hero, one prop, and one place, and those sentences travel into the shots.

treatment.title: Choose a treatment
body: A treatment is the idea, the through-line, and the lead sentence for every shot.
Pick one and the board updates on this machine.

energy.title: Calm to Hype
body: Drag from Calm to Hype and the cut re-times the shots you already have.
The beat grid updates in place, morphs stay at two or fewer, and the slider never calls the GPU.

looks.title: Transitions and presets
body: Presets and Randomise change the look and the handoff between forms.
The recipe code carries that board to another desk.

gate.title: Test clips and the GPU estimate
body: The highlighted line is the GPU estimate for this tier.
Approve one or two test clips before a full Turbo, Draft, or Final batch.
Live is not gated, and ticking a clip does not render.

generate.title: Generate a draft
body: Draft is the tier that would send the board to ComfyUI.
Press Generate. This tour does not start that job.
generate.sim: Simulated. No GPU job was started. The bundled demo stands in.

review.title: Review and undo
body: Review & fix reads the board on this machine and lists what to change.
Undo puts the previous board back after a fix, and neither one loads a model.

share.title: Share cut
body: Share cut exports a 720p H.264 file under 16 MB from the picture you already have.
It does not re-render the shots.

easy-song.title: Choose a song
body: Drop a track, or press Bundled demo.
This step does not start a picture.

easy-vibe.title: Pick a vibe
body: Choose a card. The optional line can stay empty.
The picture follows that card.

easy-make.title: Press Make
body: Make builds the cut with the defaults.
If this machine has no picture engine, it plays here instead.
easy-make.sim: Simulated. No GPU job was started. The bundled demo stands in.

weights.title: Open weights
body: The default path is local open weights: Z-Image Turbo for stills, LTX-2.3 for video, and LTX 0.9.5 for morphs.
Add-ons stay off. The badge reads Open weights and links to the licence page.

tours.blurb: The full walk, from the song to the share cut.
